subject: I am developing shiny apps for work and I need to know if, when anyone uses the app, the loaded data is stored or deleted when the user stops the app.

messages.author: 0b411a90d82f857a
messages.subject: I am developing shiny apps for work and I need to know if, when anyone uses the app, the loaded data is stored or deleted when the user stops the app.
parts:
Hi,

I think I know the answer but I would like to hear it in a less "bureaucratic" language.

I believe, from reading this post (https://stackoverflow.com/questions/40879254/r-shiny-is-uploaded-data-safe-and-secure), that the safety and policies concerning data depend on the server you use and that shinyapps.io is a safe option and fits my needs in terms of not making one's data public in any way. 

So..

When a user/colleague uses the Shiny App through Shinyapps.io and uploads data on it, will that data be public? Will the data be deleted right after the end of the user's session? Is the Stackoverflow post saying what I think it's saying?

Thank you very much,

CP
